faq.title: Coach content FAQs
faq.description: Everything you need to know before we start working together.

question_answer_list.question: Do I need to post the content myself?
question_answer_list.answer: Yes. We deliver everything as an editable Canva link with captions, so you stay in control of your account and can post on your own schedule.

question_answer_list.question: Will it actually look like my brand?
question_answer_list.answer: Every client gets a custom visual system built from their colours, photos and voice. You approve the system and every batch before anything goes out.

question_answer_list.question: Do I need a paid Canva account?
question_answer_list.answer: No. Everything works with a free Canva account.

question_answer_list.question: How do payments work?
question_answer_list.answer: We invoice monthly in advance in USD (or INR for clients in India). There’s no lock-in: cancel any time with 30 days’ notice.

question_answer_list.question: Can you also build my website?
question_answer_list.answer: Yes. Coach websites start at $1,200 / ₹59,999 and are designed to match your Instagram brand. Add the Care Plan and we’ll look after hosting and updates.
